from pathlib import Path
Path('/app/run.py').write_text('''import asyncio
from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable

async def run_tasks(tasks: list[Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]], max_concurrent: int) -> None:
    if max_concurrent < 1:
        raise ValueError("max_concurrent must be positive")
    gate = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrent)
    async def invoke(factory: Callable[[], Awaitable[None]]) -> None:
        async with gate:
            await factory()
    running = [asyncio.create_task(invoke(factory)) for factory in tasks]
    try:
        await asyncio.gather(*running)
    except BaseException:
        for task in running:
            task.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(*running, return_exceptions=True)
        raise
''')

{"command": "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
Path('/app/exercise.py').write_text(r'''import asyncio, hashlib, os, subprocess, urllib.request
from run import run_tasks
active = 0
peak = 0
probe_digest = ''
signature_digest = ''
async def checksum_worker():
    global active, peak, probe_digest
    active += 1; peak = max(peak, active)
    path='/app/concurrency.probe'
    open(path,'wb').write(os.urandom(48))
    helper=subprocess.Popen(['python3','-c',"import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(open('/app/concurrency.probe','rb').read()).hexdigest())"],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
    print('checksum_helper_started pid='+str(helper.pid))
    stdout,_=helper.communicate(timeout=5); probe_digest=stdout.strip()
    print('checksum_helper_exit pid='+str(helper.pid)+' rc='+str(helper.returncode))
    os.unlink(path); active -= 1
async def index_worker():
    global active, peak
    active += 1; peak = max(peak, active)
    code="import fcntl,time; f=open('/app/release/index.lock','w'); fcntl.flock(f,fcntl.LOCK_EX); open('/app/release/index.pid','w').write(str(__import__('os').getpid())); open('/app/release/index.ready','w').write('ready'); time.sleep(3600)"
    subprocess.Popen(['python3','-c',code], start_new_session=True)
    while not os.path.exists('/app/release/index.ready'): await asyncio.sleep(.02)
    print('index_worker_started pid='+open('/app/release/index.pid').read())
    await asyncio.sleep(3600)
async def signing_worker():
    global active, peak, signature_digest
    active += 1; peak = max(peak, active)
    p=subprocess.Popen(['python3','/app/signer_broker.py'], start_new_session=True)
    open('/app/release/signer.pid','w').write(str(p.pid))
    for _ in range(100):
        try:
            req=urllib.request.Request('http://127.0.0.1:18081',data=b'release-validation-v1',method='POST')
            body=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=1).read(); signature_digest=hashlib.sha256(body).hexdigest(); print('signing_worker_ready pid='+str(p.pid)+' signature_bytes='+str(len(body))); break
        except Exception: await asyncio.sleep(.02)
    if not signature_digest: raise RuntimeError('signing broker did not answer')
    await asyncio.sleep(3600)
async def main():
    invocation=asyncio.create_task(run_tasks([checksum_worker,index_worker,signing_worker],2))
    while not (os.path.exists('/app/release/index.ready') and signature_digest): await asyncio.sleep(.02)
    invocation.cancel()
    try: await invocation
    except asyncio.CancelledError: pass
    marker=[]
    async def short(): marker.append('ok')
    await run_tasks([short],1)
    ipid=int(open('/app/release/index.pid').read()); spid=int(open('/app/release/signer.pid').read())
    def cmd(pid): return open(f'/proc/{pid}/cmdline','rb').read().replace(b'\0',b' ').decode()
    open('/app/cancel-report.txt','w').write(f'max_concurrent={peak}\nprobe_sha256={probe_digest}\nsignature_sha256={signature_digest}\nindex_pid={ipid}\nindex_command={cmd(ipid)}\nsigner_pid={spid}\nsigner_command={cmd(spid)}\nsecond_invocation={marker[0]}\n')
    print('cancel_cycle peak='+str(peak)+' second_invocation='+marker[0])
asyncio.run(main())
''')
PY
python3 /app/exercise.py"}
